workflow: Six independent AI authors, each responsible for two locales and full own-source self-review; no cross-translation, no cross-author reading/review per publisher instruction 2026-10-14.

self-review-en-vi.json.scope: Every own English and Vietnamese title, paragraph, prompt, term and image alternative was compared in full against the exact Japanese, followed by bounded self-corrections and fresh rereading. No other author pair or review was read.

criticalChecks.134: Member fit/detailing versus interfaces, front-view versus all completed visible parts, concealed parts and check timing; no connection method invented.
criticalChecks.135: Straight alignment versus reference position, coplanarity versus material/thickness, viewing-dependent curvature, surface unevenness versus horizontal orientation; no tolerances added.
criticalChecks.136: Horizontal 陸/readings and flat-roof drainage distinction, planned inclination versus defects, 拝む site meaning, right angles between two directions, height versus upper/lower endpoints.
criticalChecks.137: Premade clearance versus free dimensional change, offset mark versus member allowance, boundary work versus trim, fit versus strength/watertightness, build-out reference surfaces; no arbitrary dimensions.
criticalChecks.138: Preparation versus rework, partial correction and pending interface checks, outstanding work versus personal evaluation, lippage/joint offset, base-role 捨て and full-area ベタ versus unnecessary material or completed functions.
criticalChecks.139: Recurring pitch versus position from reference; shaku/sun ratio, approximate conversions and exact digit order; ken approximate versus specified dimensions; area versus length and rounding; no site-rights judgment.
criticalChecks.140: RC reinforcing steel/concrete, S structural steel versus reinforcing bars, SRC integrated members versus different structural parts; timber/block structure versus finishes/fences; no seismic/design claim.

criticalChecks.134: All 191-unit batch fields self-compared. This session preserves coordination/fit as position/dimension/use relationships, concrete issue reports not arbitrary redesign; interfaces do not all require no gaps. Front-facing face versus all dimensions, completed visible parts not oblique-only, hidden parts not no-check areas, and before-covering records versus exterior-photo proof retained. Quoted learning descriptions retained with native meanings.
criticalChecks.135: Every field reread: alignment versus correct drawing position; flush surfaces do not imply same material/thickness/backside/fixing. Curvature descriptions depend on viewing side and reference, planned curve versus defect, no universal reverse-view naming or tolerance. Unevenness retains both ふろく/ふりく readings; surface irregularities differ from orientation or planned slope, not every nonhorizontal surface uneven.
criticalChecks.136: Every field reread: 陸 both ろく/りく readings, flat roof not universal zero drainage slope. Planned inclination versus error and 拝む not prayer/greeting, no cause/repair instruction or arbitrary movement. Right-angle relationship requires two directions, not a horizontal line alone; quoted 直角です with gloss. 建端/立端 read たっぱ as height, distinct upper/lower ends and datum-to-position versus member length.
criticalChecks.137: Every field reread: preallowed dimension/space allowance not arbitrary change, 逃げ versus offset 逃げ墨 distinction visible in Japanese. Boundary work versus trim member, presence not full waterproof/joint function guarantee. Fit/contact appearance not strength/watertight proof or instruction to fill every gap. Build-out projects finished face relative to reference, planned versus overdesign result, surrounding interfaces and no dimensional design.
criticalChecks.138: Every field reread: advance planning versus rework result, condition changes not automatic blame. Local correction scope and responsible checks, no free cutting/moving. 駄目/駄目直し remaining/snags versus judgment of people, count not completion/method. Lippage/offset surfaces/joints with no name-only cause/repair; 捨て substrate and ベタ full-coverage meanings not waste/all-functions proof.
criticalChecks.139: Every field reread: pitch repeats specified references not all dimensions, 追う from datum versus adjacent spacing. Source decimal and Arabic sequences exactly preserved: 10,1,30.3,3.03;3.03,6.06;1.8,1.818;3.306. Shaku/sun ratio and approximations, centimetres/millimetres and drawing precedence, ken rounded versus adopted dimension, tsubo area versus lengths and squared unit preserved. No cutting tolerances, site shape or rights judgment added.
criticalChecks.140: Every field reread: exact RC/S/SRC and Reinforced Concrete/Steel tokens; structural classification versus finish/use/individual visible materials. Steel reinforcement versus steel-frame members, different floors S/RC not automatically SRC; integral frame/rebar/concrete composition versus separate portions. Timber primary structure versus wood finish; concrete blocks as structure versus any fence/interior block wall. No seismic qualification, connection/rebar/design procedure.
